name: Autonoma
description:
Autonoma runs your end-to-end tests against a live preview deployment of your app on every pull request. When a preview fails to build or deploy, or a test fails because the app itself is broken, this connector gives Claude the same live evidence you'd otherwise dig up in a dashboard: deploy status, build and runtime logs, a rule-based diagnosis, and the full env-var/secret surface for the affected service.

Claude can also apply the fix directly - set a missing secret value, edit a service's build or wiring config, or reshape the preview (add/remove an app or a service) - then wait for the rebuild and confirm it came back up, all without leaving the conversation.

Every tool is scoped to the repo you name (or that Claude infers from context); access is limited to the organizations and repos your Autonoma account belongs to. Requires an Autonoma account with at least one app connected and a pull request with an active preview deployment.

This is an MCP to debug and fix broken Autonoma preview deploys.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Autonoma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Autonoma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://autonoma.app/v1/mcp/debug. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Autonoma MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Autonoma lists 13 MCP tools, including apply_config, diagnose_deploy, edit_previewkit_config, get_app_logs, get_build_logs, get_config, get_deploy_status, get_endpoints, get_investigation, get_secret_status, list_apps, and set_secret.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Autonoma?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Autonoma in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Autonoma requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Autonoma is developed by Autonoma AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
